enunciado: Fill a 3x4 matrix with m[i][j] = i * 4 + j + 1 and show it traversing by rows; then show its elements traversing by columns on a single line.
objetivos: Declare matrices and access them with two indexes
pistas: m[i][j]: i is the row, j the column.
By rows: the outer loop goes over i.
By columns: the outer loop goes over j.
